function.name: get_team_ranking
function.description: Retrieve the current ranking of a football team in a specific league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the football team.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "巴塞隆納在歐洲冠軍聯賽和曼聯在西甲聯賽的目前排名分別是多少？" They want the current ranking of Barcelona in the UEFA Champions League and Manchester United in La Liga. We need to call the function get_team_ranking twice: once for Barcelona in UEFA Champions League, once for Manchester United in La Liga.

We should respond with a function call. According to guidelines, we can only use one function call per response. But we have two queries. We could combine them into one function call? The function signature expects team and league. It returns ranking. We cannot pass multiple teams. So we need to make two calls. But guidelines say we can only do one function call per response. However, we can chain calls: first call for Barcelona, then after receiving result, call second. So we need to produce a function call for Barcelona first. Then after receiving result, produce next call. So initial response: call get_team_ranking with team="Barcelona", league="UEFA Champions League".
